entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Minimal API Validation with types using the same name #61971
  • Drop the `CustomPolicyProvider` sample app? #61969
  • Add an option to enable decoding null bytes from url encoded forms #61968
  • [OpenApi] .NET 10, XML schema transformer applies property comments on referenced schema #61965
  • Run two or more independent Blazor WASM Applications in scope of one page. #61970
  • Two-way-binding for SupplyParameterFromQuery in Blazor #61962
  • Blazor WebAssembly + MSAL: Token not refreshing when using localStorage for cacheLocation #61960
  • Continue to output the Blazor manifest (blazor.boot.json) to file system for access by bundling techniques #61958
  • System.InvalidOperationException: File length for '...\dist\favicon.ico' is not defined. #61957
    9.0.x

Closed

  • Min API Validation fails for some generic types #61388
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `aspnetcore/release/8.0` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #61839
  • Rendering huge HTML report using HtmlRenderer outside of ASP.NET Core #61950
  • Please stop injecting /_framework/aspnetcore-browser-refresh.js #61967
  • Why did I submit the request header JWT, but sometimes this Can't User. Claims get data? #61629

PullRequests

Created

  • [Blazor] Remove HotReload agent packages from dependencies of Components.WebAssembly #61964
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview5
  • [main] (deps): Bump src/submodules/googletest from `90a4152` to `5719306` #61963
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • [Blazor] Use preloading in benchmark app #61959
    area-blazor

Merged

  • Fix sanitization of type names in validations generator #61952
    area-minimal, feature-validation, 10.0-preview5
  • [main] (deps): Bump dotnet/arcade from d7540e540636883d3d080d087223d28b6b7395ae to 9bbce22e13f399ad3cb8b4b7e53960b621f92ea1 #61966
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:

Updated

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #61929
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • Update `ResourceCollectionProvider` to take advantage of Declarative persistent component state #61748
    area-blazor
  • Blazor - rendering metrics and tracing #61609
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview5
  • Add WebAssemblyHotReloadCapabilities to Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.props #61946
    area-blazor
  • [release/10.0-preview4] Backport identity template fix. #61795
    area-mvc, pending-ci-rerun
  • Follow-up: Improve stopping renderer, fix identity template #61633
    area-blazor, feature-prerendering, feature-blazor-navigation, .NET 10 Planning
